```{r body-setup, include=FALSE}
source("R/theme.R")
source("R/charts.R")
source("R/bundle.R")
source("R/security.R")
library(dplyr); library(ggplot2); library(scales); library(knitr)
options(knitr.kable.NA = "not available")
b <- load_bundle(district_id)
m <- b$meta
```

```{r header, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
dfg_txt <- if (!is.na(m$dfg)) paste0("DFG ", m$dfg) else "no DFG (charter / special)"
type_txt <- if (isTRUE(m$is_charter)) "Charter" else "Traditional public"
website_url <- safe_http_url(m$website)
web_txt <- if (!is.na(website_url))
  sprintf(' &nbsp;·&nbsp; <a href="%s">website</a>', html_escape(website_url)) else ""
cat(sprintf("**%s County** &nbsp;·&nbsp; %s district &nbsp;·&nbsp; %s\n\n",
            html_escape(tools::toTitleCase(tolower(m$county_name))),
            html_escape(type_txt), html_escape(dfg_txt)))
if (has_data(b$enr_total)) {
  latest_enr <- b$enr_total %>% filter(end_year == max(end_year)) %>% slice(1)
  cat(sprintf("> **%s students** enrolled (%s) &nbsp;·&nbsp; district code `%s`%s\n\n",
              fmt_int(latest_enr$n_students), latest_enr$end_year,
              html_escape(m$district_id), web_txt))
} else {
  cat(sprintf("> District code `%s`%s\n\n", html_escape(m$district_id), web_txt))
}
```

## Enrollment

```{r enr-trend, echo=FALSE}
if (has_data(b$enr_total)) {
  kable(b$enr_total %>% transmute(`School year` = as.character(end_year), Students = scales::comma(n_students)), caption = "Total enrollment by year")
}
```

```{r enr-trend-chart, echo=FALSE}
#| fig-cap: "Total district enrollment over time."
if (has_data(b$enr_total)) {
  print(chart_trend(b$enr_total, "end_year", "n_students",
    title = paste0(m$district_name, ": enrollment"),
    subtitle = "Total students, district-wide", ylab = "Students", value_fmt = "comma"))
} else cat("*Enrollment data not available for this district.*")
```

### Who the district serves

```{r enr-demographics, echo=FALSE}
#| fig-cap: "Racial/ethnic composition of enrollment over time (share)."
if (has_data(b$enr_race)) {
  print(chart_demographics(b$enr_race,
    title = "Demographic composition", subtitle = "Share of total enrollment by year"))
} else cat("*Demographic breakdown not available.*")
```

```{r enr-grades, echo=FALSE}
#| fig-cap: "Latest-year enrollment by grade."
if (has_data(b$enr_grades)) {
  print(chart_grades(b$enr_grades,
    title = paste0("Enrollment by grade (", b$enr_latest_year, ")"),
    subtitle = "Where the district's students are"))
} else cat("*Grade-level breakdown not available.*")
```

```{r enr-special, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
if (has_data(b$enr_special)) {
  latest <- b$enr_special %>% filter(end_year == max(end_year))
  lab <- c(econ_disadv="Economically disadvantaged", free_reduced_lunch="Free/reduced lunch",
           lep="English learners", special_ed="Students with disabilities")
  bullets <- latest %>% mutate(txt = sprintf("- **%s**: %s students (%s)",
                html_escape(ifelse(subgroup %in% names(lab), lab[subgroup], subgroup)),
                fmt_int(n_students), fmt_pct(as_pct_scale(pct, multiplier = 100))))
  cat("**Special populations (", max(latest$end_year), "):**\n\n", sep="")
  cat(paste(bullets$txt, collapse = "\n"))
}
```

NJ DOE enrollment publishes free/reduced-lunch participation, not an economically
 disadvantaged headcount. Economic disadvantage elsewhere is a reporting subgroup.

## Achievement

```{r njsla-latest, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
if (has_data(b$njsla_latest) && any(is.finite(b$njsla_latest$proficiency_rate[b$njsla_latest$series == "District"]))) {
  print(kable(b$njsla_latest, caption=paste("NJSLA grades 3–8",max(b$njsla_latest$end_year))))
  print(chart_grade_proficiency(b$njsla_latest,"Elementary and middle-school proficiency"))
} else cat("*NJSLA proficiency data not available for this district.*")
```

```{r njsla-trend, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
if (has_data(b$njsla_trend) && any(is.finite(b$njsla_trend$proficiency_rate))) {
  print(kable(b$njsla_trend %>% select(end_year,subject,grade_test,proficiency_rate,valid_scores)))
  print(ggplot(b$njsla_trend,aes(end_year,proficiency_rate,color=grade_test,group=interaction(grade_test,segment))) +
    geom_line() + geom_point() + facet_wrap(~subject) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks=unique(b$njsla_trend$end_year)) +
    labs(x=NULL,y="Proficient (%)",color="Grade") + theme_nj())
} else cat("*NJSLA trend data not available for this district.*")
```

### Achievement gaps

Rates and valid-score counts suppress independently. Gaps subtract the paired
comparison group's published rate from the disadvantaged group's published rate;
negative values indicate lower proficiency. Missing sides remain missing.

```{r njsla-gaps, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
if (has_data(b$njsla_gaps) && any(is.finite(b$njsla_gaps$gap))) {
  print(kable(b$njsla_gaps %>% select(end_year,subject,grade_test,comparison,rate_a,rate_b,gap)))
  print(chart_gap(b$njsla_gaps,"Paired subgroup achievement gaps"))
} else cat("*Not enough unsuppressed data for paired achievement gaps in this district.*")
```

## Spending

```{r spend-section, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
if (isTRUE(m$is_charter)) {
  cat("*District-level fiscal data (Taxpayers' Guide to Educational Spending) is reported for traditional districts, not charters. Spending figures are not available for this district.*")
} else if (!has_data(b$tges_pp)) {
  cat("*Per-pupil spending data not available for this district.*")
}
```

```{r spend-trend, echo=FALSE}
#| fig-cap: "Per-pupil spending (actuals) over time, with peer-group median."
if (!isTRUE(m$is_charter) && has_data(b$tges_pp)) {
  pv <- if (!is.null(b$tges_pp_peer)) b$tges_pp_peer$peer_median else NULL
  print(chart_trend(b$tges_pp, "end_year", "per_pupil",
    title = "Per-pupil spending", subtitle = "Total cost per pupil (actuals), vs peer median",
    ylab = "Per pupil ($)", value_fmt = "dollar", color = nj_gold, peer_value = pv))
}
```

```{r spend-peer, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
if (!isTRUE(m$is_charter) && has_data(b$tges_pp_peer) && is.finite(b$tges_pp_peer$value)) {
  pp <- b$tges_pp_peer
  cat(sprintf("In %s, the district spent **%s per pupil** — %s. The peer median was %s.\n\n",
    pp$year, fmt_dollar(pp$value),
    if (!is.na(pp$pctile)) peer_phrase(pp$pctile, m$n_peers, m$dfg) else "peer rank n/a",
    fmt_dollar(pp$peer_median)))
}
```

```{r spend-composition, echo=FALSE}
#| fig-cap: "How each per-pupil dollar is spent (latest year)."

  comp_row <- b$tges_comp %>% filter(end_year == max(end_year)) %>% slice(1)
  print(chart_composition(comp_row,

}

### State aid

```{r aid-categories, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
if (!isTRUE(m$is_charter) && has_data(b$aid_categories) && any(is.finite(b$aid_categories$amount))) {
  aid <- b$aid_categories %>% filter(end_year==max(end_year))
  print(kable(aid %>% select(end_year,aid_category,amount),caption="State aid categories; roll-up totals excluded"))
  print(ggplot(aid,aes(reorder(aid_category,amount),amount)) + geom_col(fill=nj_navy) +
    coord_flip() + scale_y_continuous(labels=label_dollar()) +
    labs(x=NULL,y="Dollars",title=paste("State aid",max(aid$end_year))) + theme_nj())
} else cat("*State aid categories not available for this district.*")
```

```{r grad-trend, echo=FALSE}

if (has_data(b$grad_trend)) {
  gt <- b$grad_trend %>% mutate(grad_rate = as_pct_scale(grad_rate, multiplier = 100))
  pv <- if (!is.null(b$grad_peer)) as_pct_scale(b$grad_peer$peer_median, multiplier = 100) else NULL

    ylab = "Graduation rate (%)", value_fmt = "pct", color = nj_teal, peer_value = pv))

```

```{r assess-trend, echo=FALSE}

### Discipline

```{r discipline, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
if (has_data(b$discipline)) {
  disc <- b$discipline %>% filter(profile_district_total %in% TRUE)
  metrics <- c("any_susp_pct", "outof_school_pct")
  if (nrow(disc) && any(is.finite(as.matrix(disc[metrics])))) {
    print(kable(disc %>% select(end_year,any_susp_count,any_susp_pct,outof_school_count,outof_school_pct)))
    if (has_data(b$discipline_peer)) print(kable(b$discipline_peer,
      caption = "Same-year peer median suspension rates (%)"))
    own <- disc %>% select(end_year, all_of(metrics)) %>% mutate(series = "District")
    peer <- if (has_data(b$discipline_peer))
      b$discipline_peer %>% select(end_year, all_of(metrics)) %>% mutate(series = "Peer median")
    else NULL
    rates <- bind_rows(own, peer) %>%
      tidyr::pivot_longer(all_of(metrics), names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") %>%
      arrange(series, metric, end_year) %>% group_by(series, metric) %>%
      filter(any(is.finite(value))) %>%
      mutate(segment = cumsum(c(TRUE, diff(end_year) != 1) | !is.finite(value) |
        lag(!is.finite(value), default = FALSE))) %>% ungroup()
    print(ggplot(rates, aes(end_year, value, color = series, linetype = series,
      group = interaction(series, metric, segment))) +
      geom_line(na.rm = TRUE) + geom_point(na.rm = TRUE) +
      facet_wrap(~metric, labeller = as_labeller(c(any_susp_pct = "Any suspension",
        outof_school_pct = "Out-of-school suspension"))) +
      scale_color_manual(values = c(District = nj_navy, `Peer median` = "gray60")) +
      scale_linetype_manual(values = c(District = "solid", `Peer median` = "dashed")) +
      scale_y_continuous(labels = label_number(suffix = "%")) +
      scale_x_continuous(breaks = unique(rates$end_year)) +
      labs(x = NULL, y = "Students (%)", color = NULL, linetype = NULL,
        subtitle = "Dashed: same-year peer median; lines stop at missing years or rates") + theme_nj())
  } else cat("*Discipline rates not available for this district.*")
} else cat("*Discipline data not available for this district.*")
```

## Staff

```{r staff, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
if (has_data(b$staff)) {
  s <- b$staff
  rows <- c(
    "Student-to-teacher ratio"   = s$student_teacher_district,
    "Student-to-administrator"   = s$student_admin_district,
    "Student-to-counselor"       = s$student_counselor_district,
    "Student-to-nurse"           = s$student_nurse_district
  )
  rows <- rows[!is.na(rows)]
  if (length(rows)) {
    cat(knitr::kable(data.frame(Metric = names(rows), Ratio = unname(rows)),
                     caption = sprintf("Staffing ratios (%s)", s$end_year)))
  }
} else cat("*Staffing ratio data not available for this district.*")
```

```{r staff-demographics, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
if (has_data(b$staff_demo) && "teachers_admins_students" %in% names(b$staff_demo)) {
  demo <- b$staff_demo %>% select(end_year,teachers_admins_students,ends_with("_district")) %>% select(-any_of("is_district"))
  print(kable(demo,caption="Staff and student demographics (%)"))
  plot_demo <- demo %>% tidyr::pivot_longer(ends_with("_district"),names_to="category",values_to="value") %>%
    filter(!grepl("female|male|gender",category)) %>% rename(series=teachers_admins_students)
  if (any(is.finite(plot_demo$value))) print(chart_group_compare(plot_demo,"Staff and student racial composition"))
  else cat("*Staff demographic percentages not available for this district.*")
} else cat("*Staff demographics not available for this district.*")
```

```{r footer, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
cat(sprintf(
"::: {.callout-note collapse=\"true\"}\n## Data sources & how to reproduce\n
All figures on this page are fetched from the New Jersey Department of Education via the open-source [`njschooldata`](https://github.com/almartin82/njschooldata) R package. Nothing is hand-entered or estimated.\n
```r
library(njschooldata)
fetch_enr(%s, tidy = TRUE) |> dplyr::filter(district_id == \"%s\")   # enrollment
fetch_grad_rate(%s) |> dplyr::filter(district_id == \"%s\")          # graduation
fetch_tges(%s)                                                       # spending (TGES)
```\n
Suppression: small cells are suppressed at the source by NJ DOE and appear as missing. Spending uses TGES \"actuals\"; peer comparisons use District Factor Group (DFG) peers.\n:::\n",
if (is.na(b$enr_latest_year)) 2026 else b$enr_latest_year, m$district_id,
if (has_data(b$grad_peer)) b$grad_peer$year else 2025, m$district_id,
if (has_data(b$tges_pp)) max(b$tges_pp$end_year) else 2025))
```

```{r deeper-reproduce, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
calls <- c(njsla_trend="fetch_spr_proficiency_by_test",discipline="fetch_disciplinary_removals",
  hib="fetch_hib_investigations",police="fetch_police_notifications",teacher_exp="fetch_teacher_experience",
  staff_retention="fetch_spr_staff_retention",staff_demo="fetch_staff_demographics",aid_categories="fetch_state_aid")
cat("\n### Reproduce deeper sections\n\n```r\n")
for (field in names(calls)) if (has_data(b[[field]])) {
  years <- sort(unique(b[[field]]$end_year))
  for (year in years) {
    extra <- if (field=="njsla_trend") ', subject = "ela"' else ""
    level <- if (field=="aid_categories") "" else ', level = "district"'
    cat(sprintf("%s(%s%s%s) # district %s\n",calls[[field]],year,extra,level,m$district_id))
    if (field=="njsla_trend") cat(sprintf('fetch_spr_proficiency_by_test(%s, "math", level = "district")\n',year))
  }
}
cat("```\n")
```
